_comment: Single source of truth for the arm. Read by matlab/ and by tools/gen_firmware_config.py (firmware/mearm_ik/config.h). Lengths in mm, angles in degrees. Link lengths are the nominal MeArm values; measure your own build and update them.

joints._comment: servo_center_deg = servo command (0-180) at the joint's reference pose: base pointing straight ahead, upper arm vertical, forearm horizontal. sign flips direction. Calibrate on your arm.

linkage._comment: The parallel linkage stops the forearm folding too far onto the upper arm or opening past straight. Angle between upper arm and forearm, measured at the elbow.

servo._stall_comment: 1.8 kg cm at 4.8 V, manufacturer datasheet

loads_assumed._comment: Estimates for the torque analysis, not measurements.
